about: PAT13 of OpenNeuro ds001226 (CC0), two-tensor UKF named by RapidParc, one of the twelve patients of the fixed cohort (Mike Halle's tractline's; Contents/tools/dmri-cohort.ts wrote it with the commit that adds distortion rule 2, 2026-10-03). The regression test (cases.regression.test.ts) reruns the case and compares; a deliberate change that moves these numbers rewrites this file in the same commit, with the reason. Rule 2 of the distortion correction (distortion.ts): the field estimated together with the PA scan's movement between the two scans, alpha 500 (validation step 4; Ron, 2026-10-03: "Build"). Rewritten 2026-10-04: Tracking rule 2 (tracking-rules.ts; Ron, 2026-10-03: 'please follow Mike's lead'): plain two-tensor UKF, the shell nearest b = 3000, every brain voxel a seed, seed FA 0.1, stop at FA 0.08 or mean signal 0.06, a point every 1.8 mm, inside the brain mask -- Mike Halle's tractline's, the ORG atlas's. Rewritten 2026-10-04: Aligned to the T1 (registration.ts, Ron 2026-10-03: 'Number three, go'): the corrected b = 0 aligned rigidly to the case's T1 on normalized gradient fields (as Mike Halle's tractline), and the scan read once onto the T1's axes through the move and the distortion field; tracked by tracking rule 2. Rewritten 2026-10-03: After the critic (qa/2026-10-03-dmri-rule2-registration.md): the T1-aligned grid keeps the scan's voxel volume and covers the brain plus a margin; the scan's edge voxels are kept. Rewritten 2026-10-04: tracking rule 3 is the default (2026-10-04): the brain from SynthStrip on the T1 Rewritten 2026-10-04: rule 3 after the critic's round (2026-10-04): the brain only where the scan has data, a fixed 4-voxel box margin Rewritten 2026-10-04: tracking rule 4 is the default (2026-10-04 evening): rule 3 without the fluid; within6 added Rewritten 2026-10-04: rule 3 with the outside-the-brain naming (outside-brain.ts) and the 6 mm list (2026-10-04 evening) Rewritten 2026-10-04: rule 3, the 6 mm list with the gray band; the outside-the-brain naming built but off (2026-10-04 night) Rewritten 2026-10-04: rule 3, the 6 mm list with the gray band, the outside-the-brain test off (recorded as 0); after the critic's round on the build (2026-10-04 night) Rewritten 2026-10-05: head-movement correction (motion rule 1) became the default, albula-diffusion 78055ef: each image put back where the head was before the fit
corrected: corrected with PA (shifts up to 19.6 mm; 15% of the two scans' difference left); movement between the two scans allowed for; head movement corrected (largest 1.2 mm and 0.8°; the images agree with each other 16% better); aligned to the MRI of the anatomy (moved 0.7 mm and 1.2°)
brain: SynthStrip's brain mask of the T1
